split_count_reconciliation: The per-split distinct-cluster counts sum to 11,091 because 48 clusters contain separate proteins assigned to both the training and in-distribution random-test sets. Subtracting this intentional overlap gives the 11,043 unique clusters in the pooled dataset. The divergent test shares zero clusters with either training or random test.

bootstrap.note: The original implementation repeatedly materialized and concatenated residue-index arrays for sampled clusters. The optimized implementation uses per-cluster residue and correct-prediction counts while preserving the same cluster-resampling procedure and residue-weighted statistic.

reproducibility_checks.canonical_split_invariance: PASS: scrambling manifest row order and arbitrary cluster labels recovered identical biological train/random/divergent membership.
reproducibility_checks.bootstrap_equivalence: PASS: the optimized bootstrap reproduced the frozen computation. The paired Delta interval differed only at floating-point roundoff; the G bootstrap matched replicate-for-replicate.
reproducibility_checks.checkpointed_rerun: The final checkpointed rerun reproduced the saved primary metrics and final confidence intervals. Because it reused the same trained probe checkpoints, this is not claimed as an independent end-to-end retraining determinism test.
